concepts.name: A · 延续塑形页
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one polished 16:9 desktop landscape pottery painting interface concept, approximately 1672 by 941 composition.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED visual-style reference: preserve its warm ivory and taupe light, fine plaster texture, creamy airy background with diagonal dappled sunlight, refined Chinese Songti serif typography, translucent warm frosted-glass UI, hairline white borders, subtle soft shadows, muted brown active controls. This must feel like the next page in exactly the same application.
Input image 2 is a FUNCTION inventory only: its current painting UI is too cluttered. Redesign hierarchy and grouping substantially. Do not reproduce its crowded dual columns or tiny repetitive text.
No brand, no logo, no header/navigation bar, no room, furniture or architectural 3D scene. Background is a simple photographic two-dimensional light plate. The only dimensional subject is an editable pottery jar on a thin warm stone turntable, matching the small squat jar in reference 1: rounded belly, short neck, open mouth, thickness, realistic interior and subtle handmade rings. This is the painting stage BEFORE firing: pale ivory matte bisque ceramic with tactile fine pores, not a glossy completed vase. Across its front show a few beautiful broad softly feathered layered blue-green pigment strokes and one deep cobalt leaf-like thin stroke, with visible translucent overlaps and bristle texture; lower body remains unpainted. Do not draw a decorative finished kiln glaze over the whole pot. Make the jar photorealistic and inviting, large enough to paint, with correctly grounded contact shadow.
UI must be elegant, restrained and confidently readable at laptop landscape sizes. All primary controls fully visible in ONE screen. No vertical scroll, clipped widgets or tiny paragraphs, no collapsed sections, no tooltip clutter. Only concise labels; no explanatory paragraphs, marketing slogans or defensive notes. All UI surfaces consistently frosted glass, no skeuomorphic buttons or wooden toolboxes. Neutral taupe UI, colors only in swatches and pigment. Carefully aligned rows and groups, generous whitespace, one primary action. Crisp simplified monochrome line icons.
Preserve feature access visually: material toggle "彩绘" / "效果釉", brush size and "釉量", brush/erase, four glaze methods "刷釉" "转台" "浸釉" "淋釉", two small stamp icons for leaf and flower, base coat "铺底", "撤销", "清空", four effect samples "流彩" "晶花" "铁斑" "开片", three firing options "氧化" "还原" "柴烧" with small temperatures 1240° 1280° 1320°, cooling "缓冷" / "快冷", primary "完成上色，入窑 →", camera "旋转" and zoom slider. Represent all 19 compact color swatches (cream, celadon, sea green, dark green, teal, cobalt, navy, pale blue, copper red, rust, wine, pink, mauve, purple, amber, brown, olive, grey, charcoal) with one custom-color plus button, but do not label every color. Show selected color name "天青" only. Tiny unobtrusive bottom-left progress "起点 · 塑形 · 装饰 · 烧成 · 成品", highlight 装饰.
Chinese text exact, professionally typeset, big stage number "03 / 装饰" and title "留下一层颜色". Do not place concept letters A/B/C, annotations, design captions, comparison boards or browser chrome inside the image. Output a single cohesive believable app screen, no split screen or montage.
Layout A: DIRECT CONTINUITY WITH APPROVED SCULPT PAGE. Large jar and turntable at left-center (about x=42%, y=44%); right single main frosted panel at x=67%, width30%, top6%, bottom22%, matching reference 1 proportions. Put the stage number and title inside top of this RIGHT panel. Directly below, a compact 彩绘/效果釉 segmented toggle. Then four beautifully rendered tiny curved ceramic effect sample thumbnails in one row with short labels. Below them concise firing options in one row, cooling in one row, primary action anchored bottom of right panel. Absolutely no large textual explanations. Two vertical size/amount sliders together in one very slim floating glass capsule at far left x=3%, y=20%, height30%. A single slim icon-and-short-label tool dock across the lower canvas at y=77%, width46%, with 画笔 / 擦除 / 转台 / 浸釉 / 淋釉 / 铺底 / 撤销 / 清空; include leaf/flower stamp mini icons unobtrusively alongside brush without separate card. One compact horizontal 19-color swatch strip just beneath this dock at y=87%, centered under the vessel, each swatch small but clickable. Camera and zoom at lower-right matching approved page. Do not wrap color palette into multiple rows. No left full-height sidebar. Keep the right panel calm and airy; realistic hierarchy with a large stage title, not tiny controls scattered around.
